title: Leads list UI
objective: The Leads working queue per PRD 12.4: full-column table with aging/flag styling, filters, My-leads toggle, search-as-you-type, pagination, bulk reassign with required note, empty state (spec FR-43).
scope: Table columns per FR-43 with monospace ref link, status chip, aging colors, overdue follow-up red, flag chips
Filter row + My leads toggle (default from breadth permission), search, sort, 25/page count summary
Bulk selection + permission-bound Reassign dialog (note required)
Empty state with Clear filters and + New Lead
out_of_scope: Export generation (T-039; button renders disabled-tooltip until then)
implementation_details: features/leads/LeadsListPage.tsx using shared DataTable: columns Lead ID (monospace link), Party, Broker, Product/Cover (two-line), Premium right-aligned (estimated vs quoted per row DTO), Status StatusChip, Age (amber >= tenant aging_amber_days, red >= aging_red_days from settings in session), Owner, Next follow-up (red + Overdue chip when past), Flags (chip set: Escalated, SLA, Expiring, High value)

LeadsFilterBar.tsx: status multi-select, owner, broker, product line, region, request channel dropdowns, date-received range picker, My leads toggle (on by default when user lacks leads.view_all — mirrors A-17), free-text search debounced 250ms

Row click navigates /leads/{id}; no inline editing; checkbox column visible only with leads.assign permission; BulkReassignDialog: owner SearchSelect (eligible accountable-owner users) + required note textarea + count summary; success toast with per-lead audit note sent
Shared LeadsTable component extracted for reuse by Party detail (T-025) and drill-through views
URL-synced filter state (searchParams) so drill-throughs can deep-link

e2e: leads-list.spec.ts: columns render with chips and aging colors; filter by status+owner narrows results; My leads toggle constrains to assigned leads; search matches lead ref and party; pagination shows '1-25 of N'; bulk reassign requires note and updates owners; user without view_all sees only assigned leads; empty state actions work

findings.description: Column sorting is not implemented in the Leads list UI. AC-042 explicitly requires 'sorting ... behave per PRD 12.4' and the task scope lists 'sort', but the UI exposes no sortable column headers, no sort state, and no sort control. A `sort` query param exists in the API layer but nothing ever sets it. Note the inconsistency: V-042's Playwright steps and this task's own test_plan.e2e both omit sorting, so it is unverified by the current verification contract - orchestrator/human should either require the sort UI or amend AC-042/scope to defer it.
findings.evidence: leadsApi.ts:62 declares `sort?: string | null` and :101-102 forwards it, but LeadsListPage.tsx has no sort state and LeadsTable.tsx renders static <th> headers with no click/sort affordance. Grep for sort across src/ui/src/features/leads shows only the dormant API param.
findings.suggested_fix: Wire sortable column headers (e.g. Age, Premium, Next follow-up, Date received) to the existing `sort` param with URL-synced sort state, and add a component test; OR obtain orchestrator confirmation that sort is deferred and amend AC-042/task scope/V-042 accordingly.
findings.resolution: Verified resolved (fix iteration 2/10). Backend contract read independently at QuoteIQ.Infrastructure/Leads/LeadStore.cs:203-209: ListAsync's `sort` switch recognizes ONLY 'lead_ref', '-lead_ref', 'date_received' (asc), with the default case ordering DateReceived desc then Id desc; there is NO server sort key for premium/owner/next-follow-up. Implementor correctly wired sorting to exactly the two backend-supported columns (Lead ID -> lead_ref, Age -> date_received, since Age derives from date_received) and left the rest as plain headers. buildLeadsSortParam (leadsApi.ts:76-85) produces exactly the strings LeadStore expects (lead_ref/-lead_ref/date_received, undefined for the default dateReceived-desc so the param is omitted). LeadsListPage owns URL-synced sort/dir state (default omitted from URL), asc<->desc toggle on repeat click, page reset on sort change. SortableHeader sets aria-sort and renders a plain <th> when onSortChange is omitted, so the T-025 LeadsTable reuse seam is intact. 4 new tests (LeadsListPage.test.tsx:272-330) genuinely assert default-omitted-from-URL, click->lead_ref+URL sync, toggle->-lead_ref, and URL->date_received round-trip via a LocationProbe. Frontend checks green: typecheck clean, 129/129 tests, build clean.

findings.description: Status-chip reporting category is derived client-side by name matching (leadStatusCategory.ts) rather than from a server-authoritative field, because LeadListItemDto (T-018) projects only StatusName, not a StatusReportingCategory/canonical key. This misclassifies tenants that rename statuses away from the seeded defaults, weakening the AC-019/AC-042 'chip color follows reporting category, survives renames' guarantee. Accepted for T-027 (frontend-only, graceful, correct for default names); tracked as a backend follow-up on LeadListItemDto/ListLeadsQueryHandler - outside this task's scope.
findings.evidence: leadStatusCategory.ts:17-36 name-based deriveLeadReportingCategory; leadsApi.ts LeadListItemDto has no reporting-category field. Single-lead LeadDto already carries the field per the file's own doc comment.
findings.suggested_fix: Add StatusReportingCategory to LeadListItemDto and ListLeadsQueryHandler (mirroring LeadDto), then key StatusChip off it and delete deriveLeadReportingCategory.

findings.description: Aging amber/red thresholds are hard-coded to the spec A-12 documented defaults (amber>=8, red>=15) rather than read from the active tenant's business rules, because those thresholds are not projected onto the session/GetMe (only GET /settings/business-rules returns them, gated by business_rules.view which ordinary Leads users lack). Spec-compliant fallback; accepted for T-027; tracked as a backend session-projection follow-up mirroring the currencyCode-on-session precedent. Outside this frontend task's scope.
findings.evidence: agingThresholds.ts:19-20 DEFAULT_AGING_AMBER_DAYS=8/RED=15 passed as fixed props in LeadsListPage.tsx:301-302; useTenantCurrency documents the analogous already-solved case for currency.
findings.suggested_fix: Add agingAmberDays/agingRedDays to MembershipDto/SessionState (mirroring currencyCode) and replace the constants with a selector.

findings.description: Filter-option and eligible-owner lookups (lead_status/product_line/region/request_channel reference data, brokers, and the business-assignments-derived owner list) load from endpoints gated by admin-style permissions (reference_data.manage, brokers.view, business_assignments.view) that ordinary Leads personas (Sales Head, RM) may not hold. The UI degrades gracefully - each control disables independently and the owner picker shows an inline notice - rather than crashing. Accepted for T-027; tracked as a backend permission-surface follow-up (expose Leads-appropriate read scopes or add the data to session). Outside this frontend task's scope.
findings.evidence: LeadsListPage.tsx:124-149 each loader .catch(()=>setX(null)); LeadsFilterBar disables controls on null option sets; getEligibleLeadOwners (leadsApi.ts:151-178) returns null on the business_assignments.view 403; BulkReassignDialog renders reassign-owner-unavailable notice.
findings.suggested_fix: Provide Leads-scoped read access to the reference/broker/eligible-owner lookups (or project the minimal option sets onto the session) so the filter bar and owner picker are usable by non-admin Leads personas.

findings.description: Only two Leads-list columns (Lead ID, Age) are sortable, because the backend ListLeadsQuery/LeadStore.ListAsync `sort` switch (LeadStore.cs:203-209) recognizes only 'lead_ref', '-lead_ref', and 'date_received' — there is no server sort key for Premium, Owner, or Next follow-up. The frontend correctly wires exactly the supported keys and cannot invent server-side ordering it doesn't accept, so this is NOT a T-027 frontend defect and does NOT block AC-042. Recorded only as a tracked backend follow-up in case PRD 12.4 is later read to require sorting on additional columns: expanding sortability requires adding sort keys (and stable tiebreakers) to ListLeadsQueryHandler/LeadStore, analogous to F-003/F-004/F-005 — outside this frontend task's scope. Minor UX nuance also noted: because the Age column is bound to the date_received key, its ascending indicator corresponds to oldest-received-first (highest age first); the direction arrow reflects the underlying date_received field rather than age magnitude. Acceptable given the backend contract.
findings.evidence: LeadStore.cs:203-209 sort switch (lead_ref/-lead_ref/date_received + default DateReceived desc, Id desc); leadsApi.ts:76-85 buildLeadsSortParam maps only leadRef/dateReceived; LeadsTable.tsx:129,135 applies SortableHeader to Lead ID and Age only.
findings.suggested_fix: If broader column sorting is required by PRD 12.4, add the corresponding sort keys (with deterministic tiebreakers) to ListLeadsQueryHandler/LeadStore, then extend LeadsSortField/buildLeadsSortParam and wire the additional headers.
